title: Payments to check
intro: Payments waiting for your word. Check each against your bank: only a person confirms a payment.
loadFailed: The payments to check didn't load.
empty: Nothing to check. A payment shows here when a customer says they paid, or sends a screenshot.

confirm.title: Confirm this payment
confirm.description: Check it against your bank. This records the payment once, and the customer is told.
confirm.amountHint: Type what your bank shows arrived.
confirm.referenceHint: Optional. The UPI or bank reference from your statement.

problems.invalid: Type the amount as a number of rupees.
problems.reference: A reference is at most 60 characters.

refuse.title: Payment not received
refuse.description: Nothing is recorded. Say why you couldn't match it.

reasons.not_found: I can't find it in the bank

refuse.tellHint: They get your "payment not found" message.

dismiss.title: Dismiss this screenshot?
dismiss.description: It isn't a payment to match, and it leaves this list. The customer is not told.

preview.label: What the customer gets
preview.template: Your WhatsApp template for this message, as their chat window is closed.
preview.task: No message can go now: a task asks the lead's owner to tell them.

told.task: A task was added to tell them
